title: Add Missing Glob Filter Tests for Parity
description: Add glob filter tests (designs include, combines designGuid with glob) to Rust and Python. Add all 4 glob filter tests to C#. This achieves test parity for FilterKit glob functionality across all 5 languages.
summary:
Fixed the Delete story's Diff and Output windows perpetually stuck on "Loading delete result (...)". Root cause: `Delete.stories.tsx` was reading `diffRes.change.forward`, but `nativeDeletePieces` returns `DesignDiffOperationResult` where `change` IS the `DesignDiff` directly (no `forward`/`backward` envelope — that shape is for `DesignOperationResult` used by flatten). Because `.forward` was always `undefined`, `setDesignDiff(undefined)` kept the loading error message alive forever, and `outputDesign` fell back to `flatInputDesign`, so the diff never showed and the output never applied the deletion.

Fix: in [Delete.stories.tsx:66](compose/algorithms/.storybook/stories/Delete.stories.tsx#L66), use `diffRes.change` instead of `diffRes.change.forward`. The rest of the pipeline (`applyDesignDiff(flatInputDesign, designDiff)`) already expects a `DesignDiff`, so it now renders correctly.

Verified: other stories (Flatten correctly uses `.change.forward` because it wraps `DesignChange`; CopyAndPaste correctly uses `.change` and a bare `DesignDiff`) — no other story had the same typo.
